text: Coarse-grid NCA state + tiny implicit decoder to full res ("NCA: From Cells to Pixels", arXiv 2506.22899)
description: Research find (2026-11-23): Pajouheshgar et al. (EPFL, arXiv 2506.22899, rev. Jan 2026) run the NCA on a coarse cell grid and decode each output pixel with a tiny shared implicit MLP (local pixel coords + nearby cell states), so NCAs scale to high resolution at little extra cost. For us: keep the persistent learned state at a coarse pyramid level (reprojected like now) and decode to 2160^2 per eye per pixel; fits the low-rate periphery (ac841219) and the learned pyramid (9439aaf2). Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22899
